architecture_source_pins.observed: one PerceptionCaptureBroker per source_id, one capture_owner_id, bounded queue/drop accounting, monotonic capture time and provenance_refs
canonical logical browser sources are browser/rendered/<target_id> and browser/structural/<target_id>; one declared capture owner per source; physical/local capture is a later acceptance boundary

multiple logical sources may share one physical transport if demultiplexing/ownership are explicit; source generation/epoch must fence restarts, navigation and invalidation; monotonic ordering remains authoritative
existing temporal layer already represents clock-domain/calibration/uncertainty; generic clock-domain logic is therefore not a Trigger-6 architecture gap
local physical acceptance already plans actual browser CDP/DOM/AX hooks; Trigger-6 must refine that seam rather than create a second browser subsystem
portal/PipeWire permission/session and revocation/reconnect research already exists; CDP mapping must not duplicate capture-authority work

mapping.physical_transport: one browser debugging transport / target attachment may back two explicit logical F2 sources
logical_sources: browser/rendered/<target_id> <- Page screencast or bounded screenshot mechanism
mapping.capture_authority: preserve existing per-source broker ownership; CDP adapter produces observations only and gains no canonical truth/effect/completion authority
mapping.temporal_semantics: rendered and structural outputs may share target/session provenance but are not thereby simultaneous; each observation keeps its own F2 monotonic capture time and existing temporal fusion/uncertainty decides pairing
mapping.generation_semantics: navigation, target replacement, detach/reconnect or invalidating browser transition must advance source_generation/epoch before observations can rejoin fusion
mapping.version_semantics: bind actual Chromium/browser and CDP protocol identity; do not assume tip-of-tree experimental commands form a timeless ABI

critical_invariant: Never alias Target.SessionID with Page.screencastFrame.sessionId. The former is a string debugging-session identity; the latter is an integer screencast frame number. Shared spelling is not shared causal identity.

bounded_architecture_delta.name: BROWSER_CDP_DUALCHANNEL_PROVENANCE_HARDENING
adds: typed separation of CDP target-session and screencast-frame identities
explicit rule that target/session co-membership does not mint simultaneity

dependency_assessment: No repository-level Python packaging/dependency manifest was found at the inspected root/ref and no existing CDP/Playwright/DOMSnapshot/Screencast implementation lane was found by repository search. E2 therefore does not prescribe a client library. Dependency choice remains an E5/build discriminator and should favor the thinnest mechanism compatible with the exact target browser/runtime.
falsifiers: If a current F2 source already implements equivalent typed CDP target/session/frame/version/generation provenance, this delta collapses to documentation-only deduplication.
If actual target-browser tests show DOMSnapshot cadence or screencast behavior cannot satisfy bounded resource/skew requirements, use a thinner structural path and/or sampled screenshots instead.

If one physical CDP transport cannot maintain explicit demultiplexed ownership across the two logical source brokers without hidden shared mutable authority, split transport sessions while preserving the same source/provenance contracts.

If navigation/reconnect can be proven causally continuous under a stable target/session identity for the selected browser mechanism, generation bump rules may be narrowed, but never inferred from target_id alone.
next_discriminator: E5_IMPLEMENTATION_READY_CANDIDATE only after checking the exact target-browser/runtime: compare experimental Page.startScreencast against bounded Page.captureScreenshot, measure structural snapshot cost/skew, exercise navigation/detach/reconnect generation fencing, and verify protocol/version identity. Do not grant physical-browser or whole-system credit from this mapping.
